change2: - Added: Two missing events and two missing plugins have been added.
change3: - Added: Unnamed Profiles now have a name.  See 'Changed', below.
change5: - Changed: Unnamed Profiles are now listed as they are in Tasker, consisting of the conditions and are preceded by an asterisk and followed by a '(None or unnamed!).' plus unique ID number.  Example: '*Face Down (None or unnamed!).45'
change6: - Changed: Unnamed Profiles now appear at the beginning of the Profile directory entries (all names start with '*').
change7: - Changed: Unnamed Tasks called by Scenes are now identified as 'Unnamed/Anonymous'.
change8: - Changed: Extended Map view directory names from 40 characters long to 50 characters.
change10: - Fixed: 'File Modified' event is not displaying 'File=' value.
change11: - Fixed: Map view Scene elements are all misaligned.
change12: - Fixed: The Map view is displaying duplicate Scene 'Properties --Task:...' details.
change13: - Fixed: Program error if a 'Name' is associated with a Time or Day profile condition.
change14: - Fixed: The Diagram view gets corrupted if the diagram is greater than 4500 characters in length (e.g. a massive diagram).  The fix is to truncate those lines at 4500 characters.
change15: - Fixed: Global variables are not appearing in the Map view.
change16: - Fixed: Changed color settings are not being restored.
change17: - Fixed: Hover over Task name in the Map view displays incorrect Profile and Project.
change18: - Fixed: Hover over Scene name in Map view incorrectly displays HTML.
change19: - Fixed: Owner display when hovering over search string in Map view is off the screen.  Truncate the displayed results instead.
change20: - Fixed: Program error if the progress bar window is closed during a loop condition.
